content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to use Modbus RTU communication with third-party [product_name] PLCs such as those from various manufacturers? I've heard the hardware is similar for these products and that programming software may work across different [product_name] brands. [user_name]
No, that's not possible currently. However, there are plans to release [product_name] with an Ethernet interface later in the year.

Hi, In the German section of the forum, a member shared a Modbus software driver for use with [product_name] series [article_no]. This driver allows you to transfer I/O statuses (similar to the Excel logger tool here) to a Modbus software. You can find helpful guides such as 'Image of [product_name] as Modbus Device', 'How to use [product_name] with Modbus', and possibly 'Serial [product_name]-Bus with standard tools ([version_no])'. Hope this helps you as well! Best regards [user_name]
Hi, It is possible to use MODBUS RTU communication with [product_name] [version_no]; a dedicated library exists for this purpose.
Hi, Can you clarify who 'we' refers to and where this information can be found? Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking information about the compatibility of Modbus RTU communication between [product_name] and third-party PLC hardware. There is ambiguity regarding whether hardware and software can be shared across brands, and questions remain around the availability of relevant drivers and libraries, notably for certain [article_no] versions. Some suggestions have mentioned community-driven drivers and I/O status logging utilities, but no official or vendor-supported solution has been confirmed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that MODBUS RTU communication should be feasible between [product_name] and third-party PLCs, possibly using shared hardware and programming software. They hope for straightforward instructions and readily available drivers to enable this connectivity.
